name: CVS Pharmacy (retail)
why: Largest U.S. retail pharmacy chain (~21% Rx share, ~9,000 stores); CVS.com pharmacy account with Pay Ahead / ExtraCare.

name: Walgreens Pharmacy
why: #2 retail pharmacy (~8,000 stores); online Pharmacy Account Balance payment and ExpressPay stored card.

name: CVS Caremark
why: Largest PBM / mail-service pharmacy (~87M members); separate caremark.com billing site with order balances.

name: Express Scripts Pharmacy
why: Largest mail-order PBM pharmacy (~100M members); Autopay with maximum amount and Extended Payment Plan.

name: Walmart Pharmacy
why: ~4,600 pharmacies plus mail order; payment via the Walmart account.

name: Optum Rx / Optum Home Delivery
why: #3 PBM (~60M people); Optum Home Delivery balance payments and preferred payment method.

name: Kroger Pharmacy (and banners)
why: Largest grocery pharmacy chain (~2,200 pharmacies); My Prescriptions online payment.

name: Albertsons Companies pharmacies
why: ~1,700 pharmacies (Safeway, Vons, Jewel-Osco...); Rx Payment Manager.

name: Amazon Pharmacy (incl. PillPack, RxPass)
why: Largest online pharmacy; RxPass subscription billing and checkout charges.

name: Costco Pharmacy
why: ~600 warehouse pharmacies plus mail order; Pay Ahead and card-on-file billing.
